text:
deploy-bot: Canary RC rc-2026-03-24-1 deployed to canary-usw2. Post-deploy smoke: prefill_probe_v3 kicking off (target=250). Observed heartbeat drop ~1.2% and p95 +180ms vs baseline. tagging #eng-releases for visibility. :triage_lights:

lee: got the alert. is this on quant2 or int8 pack?

tom: it's on int8-llama-13b-pack. quick check: a subset of prefills are returning extra newline tokens, seen as `\n\n` in traces.

sre-ana: that newline duplication could cause KV alignment issues. can we immediately reduce synth concurrency so prod user traffic unaffected?

lee: reducing synth fanout to 15rps via deploybot now.

deploy-bot: synth-concurrency set=15 for canary-usw2. verification window 3m starting now.

qa-sam: local repro: run the short prompt loop with env CANARY=1 and you see sporadic p95 spikes. gist of command: `for i in {1..300}; do curl -sS -X POST https://canary.api.redwood/v1/smoke -d '{"prompt":"hey"}'; done`

tom: digged into traces: tokenizer emitted surrogate token U+FFFD for byte 0xC3 in some requests. those requests have longer decode paths and hit fallback kernels.

sre-ana: fallback kernel thrash increases tail latency. options: 1) rollback canary to previous image 2) keep canary but divert synthetic probes to older float route 3) rate-limit synth more. which do we pick?

lee: prefer option 2 short-term to gather traces. we shouldn't rollback user traffic yet.

tom: prepared route change: route-id synth-divert-0324 -> model=float16-13b. ready to apply.

lee: apply it and bump tracing to 100% for synth traffic only. also add a short log-sample hook: `kubectl logs -l app=inference -c runner --tail=200 | grep tokenizer`

deploy-bot: route synth-divert-0324 applied -> float16-13b. tracing=100% for tag canary-synth.

qa-sam: after diversion, synth p95 returned to baseline and no U+FFFD tokens in sampled traces. :white_check_mark:

sre-ana: good. open a follow-up ticket and pause rollouts until root cause fixed. please include what we saw in traces and sample commands.

lee: ticket INF-2026-142 created. summary: int8 tokenizer occasionally emits replacement char for utf-8 sequences causing kernel fallback and p95 spikes. assigned tom.

tom: I'll reproduce and add a patch for sanitizer in tokenizer + guard in kernel fallback path. will attach kernel traces and perf counters.

sre-ana: decision: keep synth diverted for 24h, rollouts paused, collect additional telemetry. if no regressions after extended harness, we can consider resuming canary ramp. closing loop. :thumbsup:
